title: Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement — One Residency at a Time
content:
**Clause.** A customer holds at most one Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement residency at a time (a limit of 1 per customer). A new assisted living admission may be opened only when the customer has no other assisted living residency in pending admission, active, on leave or notice given status.

**Memory care.** Assisted living and memory care are mutually exclusive for the same person: an assisted living admission may not be opened while the customer has a Memory Care Residency Agreement residency in pending admission, active, on leave or notice given status.

**Independent living.** An Independent Living Residency Agreement residency in active or notice given status may coexist with a new assisted living admission only when the admission source is Larkspur independent living, which marks a move from the customer's own Larkspur apartment; that independent living residency then ends under the independent living fee end rules.

**Respite.** A Larkspur respite stay under a Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement in in-stay status may coexist with a new assisted living admission only when the admission source is a Larkspur respite stay.

### Basis of the check

The statuses are read from the company's residency records for the customer before the admission is opened; a caller's description of the customer's other residencies is not the basis.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical customers)

| Customer's other holdings in the records | New assisted living admission |
|---|---|
| An assisted living residency in on leave status | Not opened |
| An assisted living residency in closed status, nothing else | Not barred by this clause |
| A memory care residency in notice given status | Not opened |
| An independent living residency in active status, admission source Larkspur independent living | May coexist |
| An independent living residency in active status, another admission source | Not permitted to coexist |
| A respite stay in in-stay status, admission source Larkspur respite stay | May coexist |
